_notes: 638 keys had no Filipino (cur = null); all are translated here.

Register: Agency console keeps the plain second person (ikaw/mo) already used — it is an internal tool for colleagues; University console (admissions offices, a customer) now uses the formal kayo/ninyo/inyo throughout, so 12 existing 'mo/iyong' strings in the university namespace were changed as well.
Spelling: Philippine English is American — 'enroll/enrollment' (the current copy mixed 'enrol/enrolment' with common's 'Naka-enroll'); unified on enroll.

One term per concept, aligned with the common namespace patch: 'offer' (not 'alok'), 'Interview' (not 'panayam'), 'Intake' (not 'Pasukan'), 'Status' (not 'Katayuan'), 'Degree' (not 'Digri'), 'Deadline' for the university's closing date and 'Takda' for a Hangyul due date, 'essay' (not 'sanaysay'), 'queue', 'Inbox', 'File', 'Insights' (was 'Mga pananaw' = viewpoints), 'urgent'.
Product names stay official: 'Agency Console', 'University Console', 'Hangyul HQ', 'Hangyul Operations'.
Official terms kept in English: admission letter / standard admission letter, notarization, apostille, consular legalization, CHSI verification, SLA, D-2/D-4.
university:v22.stage.received was 'Natanggap na', indistinguishable from 'Natanggap' (= Admitted). Rendered 'Bagong natanggap' (newly received) to keep the two stages apart.
agency:students.dShort used '{{count}}a' (araw); Filipino staff write '3d' for days, so it is '{{count}}d'.
Document vault: agency copy uses 'document vault' (the console term); the marketing privacy page keeps 'taguan ng dokumento' for lay readers.
agency:dash.workload.overdue and ws.block.overdue use the chip 'Overdue', matching common:time.overdue.
